race.comment: TRULY LOYAL (11) stepped into this grade at just start 4 last time out and lost no admirers in defeat, finishing 1.1L off the winner. Drawn wider now is a query, though he'll be better for the 1400m effort and Parnham sticks. Can get back to winning ways in a suitable race. STREAK OF GOD (9) came back to 1400m two back and scored, before repeating the dose last time out by 0.7L. Fiore hops back on board today and while this is tougher, he's hit a purple patch of form. Can extend his winning streak. FAMOUS DAIN (2) won a trial coming in before finishing 1.7L off the winner as an $18 chance. Nottle sticks and he boasts a strong second-up record. Wouldn't surprise to see him land the knockout blow. HOLLER NUFF (6) won three on-end before the break and his latest trial suggests he's back in similar order. Lightly raced with upside and can be in the finish. MEMORY PARADE (1) is right back in grade and won't be far away.
